claim.text: Gen18's deferred Arc continuation ownership avoids 8128 PendingGoal element clones and greatly lowers Rust heap allocation requests relative to retired Gen19 when the first of two same-signature heads fails in 128 sequential calls.
claim.scope: Pinned Rust-only Gen18/Gen19 native ELF64 and i686, 13 fixtures, 20 samples per version/case/ABI.
assumptions: Same exact source/query bytes and toolchain
External allocator probe samples only during solve
forbidden_promotions: No independent ISO Prolog correctness claim
Requested Layout bytes are not physical copied bytes or RSS

specification.intended_object: Nonmutating allocation-level comparison of immutable released and retired execution representations.
invariants: Exact ordered answers and CLI parity
T2 first-fail R128 128 choices and 128 redos on both versions
0 cloned PendingGoal elements on Gen18 versus 8128 on Gen19

implementation.environment: Rust 1.85.1 release on Ubuntu 24.04 true native ELF64 and i686 ELF32
implementation.live_entrypoint: gprolog_native::solve() in a matching external System GlobalAlloc binary; opt-in choicepoint-profile source counts
implementation.representation: Typed tuple of allocation calls, requested layout bytes, realloc requests and source counters

metric.name: Allocator requests, requested Layout bytes, copied-goal elements and exact answer parity
metric.units: calls; requested bytes; PendingGoal elements; exact ordered answers
equivalence_attacks: Swap order of two same-signature heads

black_box: 264 full stdout/stderr/exit CLI cases per ABI
13 complete allocator fixture answer traces per ABI
structural: Live 18-field feature-only ChoicepointProfile in both pinned libraries
Analytic T2 first-fail 0 versus 8128 copied-goal predictions
property_based: Fixed seeded generated historical Rust differential corpus
metamorphic: First head succeeds versus first fails
fuzzing: Fixed seeded generator in 264-case corpus, not unrestricted fuzzer
historical: Gen19 retirement PR #18, failed performance workflow 44290905287
Gen18 merged PR #17 and validation history

matched_baselines: Immutable released Gen18 and rejected Gen19 linked to the same external allocator diagnostic on the same ABI
negative_controls: T1, T3, T16, builtin-only (same ownership branch)
controls.compute_parity: Pinned Rust compiler, release profile, same ABI and external diagnostic; 5 AB/BA paired blocks.
controls.parameter_parity: Same limits, source program bytes and repeated query goal count per cell.
controls.sampling_parity: 3 untallied warmups and 20 tracked solves per variant/case/ABI.
controls.data_access_parity: Same source/query bytes and SHA256 within each matched case.

preregistration.prediction: T2 first-fail R128 Gen18 has zero cloned goal-elements, Gen19 has 8128, with more allocator calls and requested bytes for Gen19 in >=4/5 paired blocks on both ABIs.
preregistration.primary_metric: Typed pair of Rust allocation-request median and requested-layout bytes median, separately per ABI and first-fail R128 cell.
preregistration.uncertainty_method: 20 raw observations per version/case/ABI, 5 AB/BA blocks; no independent external replication or causal time interval.
preregistration.kill_condition: Wrong 0-versus-8128 count, changed outputs, failure of requested-allocation contrast or native ABI build failure.
preregistration.stop_condition: Do not modify solver or invent a new optimization to rescue failed results.
preregistration.promotion_rule: M only for bounded source and allocator requests if full raw evidence and both ABI gates pass; CPU-time causality remains H.

primary_sources: Pinned GitHub released Gen18 and rejected Gen19 commits
claim_to_artifact_map: Copied elements and Arc events => live profile values in alloc-contrast JSON
Allocation requests and requested bytes => GlobalAlloc samples in alloc-contrast JSON
Strict output equality => alloc-semantic JSON per ABI
Source identity => frozen Git SHAs and per-cell SHA256

result.observed: Both ABIs passed 264/264 CLI cases and 13/13 allocation fixtures. On primary T2 first-fail R128, 4228 -> 28612 alloc calls; copied elements 0 -> 8128.
result.effect_size: 6.7673x allocation requests both ABIs; requested-layout bytes 12.5544x ELF64 and 11.9648x i686; 5/5 paired blocks for both metrics.
result.uncertainty: Same project authored code, specification and test. Requested allocations deterministic for these fixed CI inputs, no external independent witness and no attribution of CPU time.
retired_claims: Fixed Gen19 T=2 owned policy as an optimization
Any claim that GlobalAlloc counts directly measure runtime cycles
active_remainder: Independent allocator profiler and semantic oracle
